cases.name: Hanna Dawsey
cases.about: Her obituary said, "She was an R.N. with St. Bernard’s Medical Center in Jonesboro, AR., and nursing instructor with Black River Technical College in Pocahontas. Hanna loved Halloween and collecting sugar skulls. She also enjoyed going to the river, fishing, singing and spending time with her family and friends. She attended Landmark Missionary Baptist Church in Corning."
